startup_ms.reason: Median of 5 launches on a hosted windows-latest runner, 36 to 68 ms per run. The budget is about 50 times that, because shared runners are noisy and a tight number would flake. It catches a startup that blocks on something slow, not small drift.

idle_rss_bytes.reason: Median working set of 5 launches on a hosted windows-latest runner, 19.1 to 20.0 MB per run, two seconds after startup. The budget is about 3 times that. It catches a large allocation at startup, not small drift.
